# Nick Harris

> Personal site of Nick Harris: founder of Skylight Studio, builder of Setlist.ID, one half of BlondeBrunette. Based in Barcelona.

Nick Harris is an entrepreneur and analytics leader based in Barcelona, Spain. Born in South Africa, raised in Florida. Founder of Skylight Studio, an enterprise AI consultancy. After a decade building analytics practices for clients including NASCAR, DoorDash, National Grid, and Tufts Health Plan, he started Skylight Studio to bring enterprise-grade AI to every business. He also makes music as one half of BlondeBrunette and builds Setlist.ID, a tool for identifying tracklists in DJ mixes. Founder and board member of ReMade BCN, a community-run makerspace in Barcelona focused on open tools, learning, and collaboration.

## Projects

- [Skylight Studio](https://skylightstudio.co): Enterprise AI consultancy founded by Nick Harris. Brings enterprise-grade AI to businesses of every size.
- [Setlist.ID](https://setlist.id): Tool for identifying tracklists in DJ mixes.
- [BlondeBrunette](https://blondebrunette.music): Music duo. Nick is one half.
- [ReMade BCN](https://www.made-bcn.org/): Community-run makerspace in Barcelona. Nick is a founder and board member.
